tagline.fr: Uplink lets you play as a freelance hacker tackling risky contracts for corporations. Break into systems, steal data, sabotage rivals, and upgrade your gear. Support factions or go rogue in this immersive, strategy-driven hacking simulation game where your choices shape the outcome.
tagline.en: Uplink lets you play as a freelance hacker tackling risky contracts for corporations. Break into systems, steal data, sabotage rivals, and upgrade your gear. Support factions or go rogue in this immersive, strategy-driven hacking simulation game where your choices shape the outcome.

tagline.fr: Garry's Mod is a physics sandbox. There aren't any predefined aims or goals. We give you the tools and leave you to play.
tagline.en: Garry's Mod is a physics sandbox. There aren't any predefined aims or goals. We give you the tools and leave you to play.

tagline.fr: D'ambitieuses mégacorporations monopolisent la conquête spatiale. Aux confins du système solaire, une découverte bouleverse l'équilibre technologique. Un nouveau conflit éclate alors : « The Jupiter Incident ».
tagline.en: D'ambitieuses mégacorporations monopolisent la conquête spatiale. Aux confins du système solaire, une découverte bouleverse l'équilibre technologique. Un nouveau conflit éclate alors : « The Jupiter Incident ».

tagline.fr: Jouez avec votre propre musique.Audiosurf est un jeu où vous utilisez votre propre musique pour créer votre propre expérience. La forme, la vitesse et l'ambiance de chaque session sera déterminée par le choix de votre morceau.
tagline.en: Ride your music. Audiosurf is a music-adapting puzzle racer where you use your own music to create your own experience. The shape, the speed, and the mood of each ride is determined by the song you choose.

tagline.fr: Shatter is a retro-inspired brick-breaking game that merges familiar action with unique twists and a modern crafted production approach.
tagline.en: Shatter is a retro-inspired brick-breaking game that merges familiar action with unique twists and a modern crafted production approach.

tagline.fr: Surrounded by enemies and assaulted by terror from all sides, Philip must collect clues and solve vexing puzzles while combating the gnawing psychological terrors that assail his mind and threaten to strip him of his sanity.
tagline.en: Surrounded by enemies and assaulted by terror from all sides, Philip must collect clues and solve vexing puzzles while combating the gnawing psychological terrors that assail his mind and threaten to strip him of his sanity.

tagline.fr: The endless darkness and the somber, long passages of a military complex have become the abode of evil, thousands of blood-thirsty creatures fill its offices, storehouses and mysterious laboratories. About 1,000 monsters on each map, showing up to 100 monsters simultaneously on one playing screen.
tagline.en: The endless darkness and the somber, long passages of a military complex have become the abode of evil, thousands of blood-thirsty creatures fill its offices, storehouses and mysterious laboratories. About 1,000 monsters on each map, showing up to 100 monsters simultaneously on one playing screen.

tagline.en: The infamous, tough-as-nails platformer comes to Steam with a playable Head Crab character (Steam-exclusive)!

tagline.fr: Incertain du sort de sa sœur, un garçon pénètre dans LIMBO
tagline.en: Uncertain of his sister's fate, a boy enters LIMBO

tagline.fr: Jouez en ligne en un contre un ou en coop. D'avantage de modes de jeu, d'ennemis et de boss. Déverrouillez et faites des améliorations tout en personnalisant votre configuration en fonction de votre style de jeu.
tagline.en: Jouez en ligne en un contre un ou en coop. D'avantage de modes de jeu, d'ennemis et de boss. Déverrouillez et faites des améliorations tout en personnalisant votre configuration en fonction de votre style de jeu.

tagline.fr: Amnesia: The Dark Descent, a first person survival horror. A game about immersion, discovery and living through a nightmare. An experience that will chill you to the core.
tagline.en: Amnesia: The Dark Descent, a first person survival horror. A game about immersion, discovery and living through a nightmare. An experience that will chill you to the core.

tagline.fr: A Zoë Mode production for the video game charity initiative OneBigGame, Chime pits gamers against the melody in this acclaimed puzzle experience.
tagline.en: A Zoë Mode production for the video game charity initiative OneBigGame, Chime pits gamers against the melody in this acclaimed puzzle experience.

tagline.fr: Recettear c'est l'histoire d'une boutique, de la fille qui y habite et de la fée qui va tout chambouler. Recette Lemongrass va se retrouver à la tête d'une boutique pour laquelle il va falloir payer les traites. Tear est votre fée et vous accompagnera.
tagline.en: Recettear c'est l'histoire d'une boutique, de la fille qui y habite et de la fée qui va tout chambouler. Recette Lemongrass va se retrouver à la tête d'une boutique pour laquelle il va falloir payer les traites. Tear est votre fée et vous accompagnera.

tagline.fr: Lorsque trois étudiants de l'Université de New York s'entretuent, personne ne pense qu'une sinistre force est à l'œuvre. Personne, sauf la jeune médium Rosa Blackwell et son nouveau guide spirituel Joey Mallone.
tagline.en: When 3 NYU students kill themselves, nobody thinks that a sinister force is at work. Nobody but fledgling medium Rosa Blackwell & her new spirit guide Joey Mallone.

tagline.fr: Nidhogg est le jeu épique primé d’escrime et de tir à la corde, agrémenté de vers géants volants.
tagline.en: Nidhogg is the epic award-winning game of fencing tug-of-war complete with flying giant worms.

tagline.fr: Creuser, survivre, explorer, construire ! Tout est possible dans ce jeu d'aventure bourré d'action. Pack de 4 jeux également disponible !
tagline.en: Dig, fight, explore, build! Nothing is impossible in this action-packed adventure game. Four Pack also available!

tagline.fr: Project Zomboid is the ultimate in zombie survival. Alone or in MP: you loot, build, craft, fight, farm and fish in a struggle to survive. A hardcore RPG skillset, a vast map, massively customisable sandbox and a cute tutorial raccoon await the unwary. So how will you die? All it takes is a bite..
tagline.en: Project Zomboid is the ultimate in zombie survival. Alone or in MP: you loot, build, craft, fight, farm and fish in a struggle to survive. A hardcore RPG skillset, a vast map, massively customisable sandbox and a cute tutorial raccoon await the unwary. So how will you die? All it takes is a bite..

tagline.fr: Une aventure d'Halloween tirée de la production "Double Fine" de Tim Schafer.
tagline.en: Une aventure d'Halloween tirée de la production "Double Fine" de Tim Schafer.

202690.title: Hegemony Gold: Wars of Ancient Greece

tagline.fr: Conquérez la Grèce antique dans Hegemony Gold : Guerre de la Grèce Antique, un jeu de stratégie de guerre épique qui développe et raffine le jeu prisé Hegemony: Philippe de Macédoine avec du tout nouveau contenu et de nouvelles fonctionnalités.
tagline.en: Conquérez la Grèce antique dans Hegemony Gold : Guerre de la Grèce Antique, un jeu de stratégie de guerre épique qui développe et raffine le jeu prisé Hegemony: Philippe de Macédoine avec du tout nouveau contenu et de nouvelles fonctionnalités.

tagline.fr: Sortez votre épée et frayez-vous un chemin vers la victoire dans ce jeu d'arcade aventure en 2D primé et signé The Behemoth !
tagline.en: Sortez votre épée et frayez-vous un chemin vers la victoire dans ce jeu d'arcade aventure en 2D primé et signé The Behemoth !

tagline.fr: Commandez une équipe de 5 soldats d'élite contre une horde d'extra-terrestres forte de 100 000 éléments. Encerclé de tous les côtés, vous devez faire preuve d'une plus grande intelligence tactique que l'ennemi.
tagline.en: Commandez une équipe de 5 soldats d'élite contre une horde d'extra-terrestres forte de 100 000 éléments. Encerclé de tous les côtés, vous devez faire preuve d'une plus grande intelligence tactique que l'ennemi.

tagline.fr: Une expérience narrative à propos de deux docteurs traversant à reculons dans les souvenirs d'une homme mourant afin de réaliser artificiellement son dernier souhait.
tagline.en: A story-driven experience about two doctors traversing backwards through a dying man's memories to artificially fulfill his last wish.

tagline.fr: Un jeu de course multijoueur à couper le souffle qui oppose 4 joueurs les uns contre les autres, en local et/ou en ligne. Courez, sautez et balancez-vous, utilisez des armes sournoises et des gadgets pour éjecter vos adversaires hors de l'écran !
tagline.en: Cut-throat multiplayer running game that pits 4 players against each other, locally and/or online. Run, jump, swing around, and use devious weapons and pick-ups to knock opponents off-screen! One of the most competitive games you'll ever play.

tagline.fr: Vous vous réveillez seul, sur une île étrange remplie d'énigmes qui vous mettront à l'épreuve et vous surprendront.
tagline.en: You wake up, alone, on a strange island full of puzzles that will challenge and surprise you.

tagline.fr: Ce jeu de simulation spatiale de type rogue-like vous permet de piloter votre vaisseau dans une galaxie générée aléatoirement où vous pourrez vous couvrir de gloire... si vous parvenez à éviter la défaite.
tagline.en: This "spaceship simulation roguelike-like" allows you to take your ship and crew on an adventure through a randomly generated galaxy filled with glory and bitter defeat.

tagline.fr: Guacamelee! Gold Edition est un jeu d'action et de plateforme de style Metroidvania, qui se déroule dans un monde magique, est inspiré de la culture et du folklore mexicain, et propose de nombreux personnages uniques et fascinants.
tagline.en: Guacamelee! is a Metroidvania-style action-platformer set in a magical Mexican-inspired world. The game draws its inspiration from traditional Mexican culture and folklore, and features many interesting and unique characters.

tagline.fr: Hotline Miami est un jeu à l'action explosive qui déborde de brutalité brute, de fusillades et de combats rapprochés sanglants et violents.
tagline.en: Hotline Miami is a high-octane action game overflowing with raw brutality, hard-boiled gunplay and skull crushing close combat.

tagline.fr: Antichamber est un jeu d'exploration psychologique et hors du commun où rien ne peut être considéré comme acquis. Découvrez un univers inspiré de l’œuvre d'Escher où les couloirs s'enroulent autour d'autres, où les espaces se reconfigurent eux-mêmes et où accomplir l'impossible peut être la seule façon d'avancer.
tagline.en: Antichamber is a mind-bending psychological exploration game where nothing can be taken for granted. Discover an Escher-like world where hallways wrap around upon each other, spaces reconfigure themselves, and accomplishing the impossible may just be the only way forward.

tagline.fr: Super Hexagon is a minimal action game by Terry Cavanagh, with music by Chipzel.
tagline.en: Super Hexagon is a minimal action game by Terry Cavanagh, with music by Chipzel.

tagline.fr: Cry of Fear is a psychological single-player and co-op horror game set in a deserted town filled with horrific creatures and nightmarish delusions. You play as a young man desperately searching for answers in the cold Scandinavian night, finding his way through the city as he slowly descends into madness.
tagline.en: Cry of Fear is a psychological single-player and co-op horror game set in a deserted town filled with horrific creatures and nightmarish delusions. You play as a young man desperately searching for answers in the cold Scandinavian night, finding his way through the city as he slowly descends into madness.

tagline.fr: Gomez est une créature 2D vivant dans un monde 2D. Enfin, c'est ce qu'il croit... Quand il découvre l'existence d'une mystérieuse troisième dimension, Gomez se lance dans une aventure qui le mènera aux confins du temps et de l'espace. Utilise ta capacité à te déplacer dans des structures 3D à partir de 4 perspectives 2D classiques.
tagline.en: Gomez is a 2D creature living in a 2D world. Or is he? When the existence of a mysterious 3rd dimension is revealed to him, Gomez is sent out on a journey that will take him to the very end of time and space. Use your ability to navigate 3D structures from 4 distinct classic 2D perspectives.

tagline.fr: Super House of Dead Ninjas is an action arcade game with roguelite elements. Race against a 30 second timer as you descend floor after foe-filled floor and attempt to unlock the secrets of this deadly tower!Play as the fearsome Crimson Ninja, wielding an arsenal of deadly ninja weapons and attacks.
tagline.en: Super House of Dead Ninjas is an action arcade game with roguelite elements. Race against a 30 second timer as you descend floor after foe-filled floor and attempt to unlock the secrets of this deadly tower!Play as the fearsome Crimson Ninja, wielding an arsenal of deadly ninja weapons and attacks.

tagline.fr: N++ est un jeu de plateforme où vitesse et action vont de pair. Vous allez devoir foncer à travers les obstacles en évitant de justesse les ennemis et récupérer de l'or dans un sublime décor minimaliste.
tagline.en: N++ est un jeu de plateforme où vitesse et action vont de pair. Vous allez devoir foncer à travers les obstacles en évitant de justesse les ennemis et récupérer de l'or dans un sublime décor minimaliste.

tagline.fr: LA-MULANA is an “Archaeological Ruin Exploration Action Game,” bringing the classic appeal of adventure with the punishing difficulty of retro-inspired gaming. Search inside ancient ruins, seeking out the “Secret Treasure of Life” – which sleeps in the sprawling ruins of “LA-MULANA” and is said to be the beginning of all civilization.
tagline.en: LA-MULANA is an “Archaeological Ruin Exploration Action Game,” bringing the classic appeal of adventure with the punishing difficulty of retro-inspired gaming. Search inside ancient ruins, seeking out the “Secret Treasure of Life” – which sleeps in the sprawling ruins of “LA-MULANA” and is said to be the beginning of all civilization.

tagline.fr: KENTUCKY ROUTE ZERO est un jeu d'aventure réaliste et magique. Il évoque une autoroute secrète, qui circule dans des galeries enterrées du Kentucky, et le peuple mystérieux qui s'y déplace.
tagline.en: KENTUCKY ROUTE ZERO is a magical realist adventure game about a secret highway running through the caves beneath Kentucky, and the mysterious folks who travel it.

tagline.fr: An American geological expedition, under a UN mandate, assesses the natural resources in a distant part of Siberia, deep in the trackless steppes of Eastern Russia. But instead of oil, they discover a deposit of a hitherto unknown mineral.
tagline.en: An American geological expedition, under a UN mandate, assesses the natural resources in a distant part of Siberia, deep in the trackless steppes of Eastern Russia. But instead of oil, they discover a deposit of a hitherto unknown mineral.

tagline.fr: Hell is an experiment you can't survive in Outlast, a first-person survival horror game developed by veterans of some of the biggest game franchises in history. As investigative journalist Miles Upshur, explore Mount Massive Asylum and try to survive long enough to discover its terrible secret... if you dare.
tagline.en: Hell is an experiment you can't survive in Outlast, a first-person survival horror game developed by veterans of some of the biggest game franchises in history. As investigative journalist Miles Upshur, explore Mount Massive Asylum and try to survive long enough to discover its terrible secret... if you dare.

tagline.fr: Félicitations !Votre nom a été sélectionné lors de la loterie du Ministère du Travail du mois d'octobre.Pour prendre vos fonctions, présentez-vous immédiatement au Ministère des Admissions du poste-frontière de Grestin.Un appartement de classe 8 vous a été affecté à Grestin Est. Vous pourrez vous y installer avec votre famille.
tagline.en: Congratulations. The October labor lottery is complete. Your name was pulled. For immediate placement, report to the Ministry of Admission at Grestin Border Checkpoint. An apartment will be provided for you and your family in East Grestin. Expect a Class-8 dwelling.

tagline.fr: Samurai GUNN is a lightning-fast Bushido brawler for 2 to 4 players. Each samurai is armed with a sword and gunn, with only 3 bullets to a life. Strategy and quick reflexes are the key to deflecting bullets and sending your opponents’ heads rolling.
tagline.en: Samurai GUNN is a lightning-fast Bushido brawler for 2 to 4 players. Each samurai is armed with a sword and gunn, with only 3 bullets to a life. Strategy and quick reflexes are the key to deflecting bullets and sending your opponents’ heads rolling.

240720.title: Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy

tagline.fr: A game I made for a certain kind of person. To hurt them.
tagline.en: A game I made for a certain kind of person. To hurt them.

tagline.fr: Nuclear Throne est un jeu de tir roguelike post-apocalyptique en vue du dessus. Dans ce monde post-apocalyptique, l'humanité a disparu, et des monstres et mutants rôdent sur Terre. Parviendrez-vous à atteindre le Trône nucléaire ?
tagline.en: Nuclear Throne is a post-apocalyptic roguelike-like top-down shooter. Not 'the final hope of humanity' post-apocalyptic, but 'humanity is extinct and mutants and monsters now roam the world' post-apocalyptic. Can you reach the Nuclear Throne?

tagline.fr: As the lone survivor of a passenger jet crash, you find yourself in a mysterious forest battling to stay alive against a society of cannibalistic mutants. Build, explore, survive in this terrifying first person survival horror simulator.
tagline.en: As the lone survivor of a passenger jet crash, you find yourself in a mysterious forest battling to stay alive against a society of cannibalistic mutants. Build, explore, survive in this terrifying first person survival horror simulator.

tagline.fr: In this city-building strategy game, you control a group of exiled travelers who decide to restart their lives in a new land. They have only the clothes on their backs and a cart filled with supplies from their homeland. The townspeople of Banished are your primary resource.
tagline.en: In this city-building strategy game, you control a group of exiled travelers who decide to restart their lives in a new land. They have only the clothes on their backs and a cart filled with supplies from their homeland. The townspeople of Banished are your primary resource.

tagline.fr: Released in 2014, experience one of the first 3D adaptations of the renowned puzzle-adventure game Myst! Each discovery you make, every puzzle you solve, will bring you closer to reversing a wrong that has gone unchecked for ages.
tagline.en: Released in 2014, experience one of the first 3D adaptations of the renowned puzzle-adventure game Myst! Each discovery you make, every puzzle you solve, will bring you closer to reversing a wrong that has gone unchecked for ages.

tagline.fr: Hungry? Take your restaurant from a one star abomination to a five star wonder in Cook, Serve, Delicious! Plan your menu, upgrade your equipment, and master challenges with easy-to-learn, hard-to-master gameplay!
tagline.en: Hungry? Take your restaurant from a one star abomination to a five star wonder in Cook, Serve, Delicious! Plan your menu, upgrade your equipment, and master challenges with easy-to-learn, hard-to-master gameplay!

tagline.fr: Crypt of the NecroDancer est un jeu de rythme roguelike primé. Bouge sur la musique et bats-toi en suivant les pulsations ! Groove avec la bande-son épique de Danny Baranowsky, ou choisis des chansons de ta propre collection MP3 !
tagline.en: Crypt of the NecroDancer is an award winning hardcore roguelike rhythm game. Move to the music and deliver beatdowns to the beat! Groove to the epic Danny Baranowsky soundtrack, or select songs from your own MP3 collection!

tagline.fr: Freedom Planet est un jeu de plate-forme de combat inspiré de dessins animés où une dragonoïde téméraire et ses amies affrontent une attaque d'aliens.
tagline.en: Freedom Planet est un jeu de plate-forme de combat inspiré de dessins animés où une dragonoïde téméraire et ses amies affrontent une attaque d'aliens.

tagline.fr: DINOSAURS. PIXELS. PYROCLASTIC DOOM WALLS. Escape extinction in this colorful take on the classic prehistoric runner. Upgrade your raptor with new stats and cute hats, and then outrun the end of the world in endless, procedurally generated landscapes.
tagline.en: DINOSAURS. PIXELS. PYROCLASTIC DOOM WALLS. Escape extinction in this colorful take on the classic prehistoric runner. Upgrade your raptor with new stats and cute hats, and then outrun the end of the world in endless, procedurally generated landscapes.

tagline.fr: Door Kickers is an innovative realtime strategy game that puts you in charge of a SWAT team and lets you command them during a tactical intervention.
tagline.en: Door Kickers is an innovative realtime strategy game that puts you in charge of a SWAT team and lets you command them during a tactical intervention.

tagline.fr: Risk of Rain is an action platformer with roguelike elements. With permanent death as a primary feature, players will have to play their best to get as far as possible. Fight on a mysterious planet with randomly spawning enemies and bosses, either alone or with 3 friends in online co-op.
tagline.en: Risk of Rain is an action platformer with roguelike elements. With permanent death as a primary feature, players will have to play their best to get as far as possible. Fight on a mysterious planet with randomly spawning enemies and bosses, either alone or with 3 friends in online co-op.

tagline.fr: Super Amazing Wagon Adventure is a fast-paced 2d shooting game with a random story. You control a group of three migrants traveling west along a wagon trail. The game consists of short scenes that are sequenced together in a semi-random way to tell a crazy adventure story.
tagline.en: Super Amazing Wagon Adventure is a fast-paced 2d shooting game with a random story. You control a group of three migrants traveling west along a wagon trail. The game consists of short scenes that are sequenced together in a semi-random way to tell a crazy adventure story.

tagline.fr: Shovel Knight: Treasure Trove, l’édition complète de Shovel Knight, regroupe les 5 jeux de la saga ! Frayez-vous un chemin à coup de pelle et d'explosions dans un univers de plates-formes exigeant, peuplé de personnages mémorables et inspiré des classiques d'action/aventure de l'ère 8-bits.
tagline.en: Shovel Knight: Treasure Trove is the complete Shovel Knight collection, containing all 5 games in the epic saga! Dig, blast, slash, and bash your way through a fantastical, 8-bit inspired world of pixel-perfect platforming, memorable characters, and world-class action-adventure gameplay.

tagline.fr: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth is a randomly generated action RPG shooter with heavy Rogue-like elements. Following Isaac on his journey players will find bizarre treasures that change Isaac’s form giving him super human abilities and enabling him to fight off droves of mysterious creatures, discover secrets and fight his way to safety.
tagline.en: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth is a randomly generated action RPG shooter with heavy Rogue-like elements. Following Isaac on his journey players will find bizarre treasures that change Isaac’s form giving him super human abilities and enabling him to fight off droves of mysterious creatures, discover secrets and fight his way to safety.

tagline.fr: TowerFall Ascension is the definitive version of the hit archery combat game. Inspired by classics from the golden age of couch multiplayer, it's a 4-player local party game centering around hilarious, intense versus matches. The core mechanics are simple and accessible, but hard to master and combat is fierce.
tagline.en: TowerFall Ascension is the definitive version of the hit archery combat game. Inspired by classics from the golden age of couch multiplayer, it's a 4-player local party game centering around hilarious, intense versus matches. The core mechanics are simple and accessible, but hard to master and combat is fierce.

tagline.fr: LOVERS IN A DANGEROUS SPACETIME est un shooter spatial en coop à bord d'un immense vaisseau fluorescent. Le travail d'équipe est le maître mot pour combattre les forces maléfiques de l'Anti-Amour, sauver les lapins stellaires et échapper à une mort certaine au fond d'un trou noir.
tagline.en: Explore a neon galaxy in your very own battleship in this 1- to 4-player couch co-op adventure.

tagline.fr: SteamWorld Dig is an action-adventure puzzler with strong Metroidvanian influences set in the SteamWorld Universe. You’ll need to dig deep into the earth, gather resources to upgrade your tools and abilities, take on enemies, solve challenging puzzles and uncover the secrets to save a dying town.
tagline.en: SteamWorld Dig is an action-adventure puzzler with strong Metroidvanian influences set in the SteamWorld Universe. You’ll need to dig deep into the earth, gather resources to upgrade your tools and abilities, take on enemies, solve challenging puzzles and uncover the secrets to save a dying town.

tagline.fr: Dans Rust, le seul but est de survivre. Sur cette île, tout ce qui vous entoure est une menace : la faune, la nature, les autochtones, sans oublier les survivants eux-mêmes. Il ne vous faudra reculer devant rien, si vous voulez voir un nouveau jour se lever.
tagline.en: The only aim in Rust is to survive. Everything wants you to die - the island’s wildlife, other inhabitants, the environment, and other survivors. Do whatever it takes to last another night.

tagline.fr: Control a car full of jerks as they explore cities, recruit weird people, rescue dogs, argue with each other, and face gigantic swarms of slow zombies. Randomly generated for a new story and rare events every time you play!
tagline.en: Control a car full of jerks as they explore cities, recruit weird people, rescue dogs, argue with each other, and face gigantic swarms of slow zombies. Randomly generated for a new story and rare events every time you play!

tagline.fr: Shoot! Dodge! and... Get Hit!? "Ikaruga" is a vertical shoot 'em up that features an unique polarity-switching gameplay. Switch the ship's polarity and "get hit and absorb" enemy bullets! Achieve High Score with the chain bonus!
tagline.en: Shoot! Dodge! and... Get Hit!? "Ikaruga" is a vertical shoot 'em up that features an unique polarity-switching gameplay. Switch the ship's polarity and "get hit and absorb" enemy bullets! Achieve High Score with the chain bonus!

tagline.fr: Le Principe de Talos est un jeu d'énigme philosophique à la première personne de Croteam (Serious Sam), écrit par Tom Jubert (FTL, Le Swapper) et Jonas Kyratzes (Infinite Ocean). Résolvez des énigmes complexes tissées dans une parabole métaphysique sur l'intelligence et le sens dans un monde condamné.
tagline.en: The Talos Principle is a first-person puzzle game in the tradition of philosophical science fiction. Made by Croteam and written by Tom Jubert (FTL, The Swapper) and Jonas Kyratzes (The Sea Will Claim Everything).

tagline.fr: Explore a beautiful, vast and ruined world riddled with dangers and lost technologies.
tagline.en: Explore a beautiful, vast and ruined world riddled with dangers and lost technologies.

tagline.fr: Lethal League est un jeu de combat de projectile où vous devez envoyer une balle anti-gravité sur votre adversaire pour gagner. La balle accélère à chaque coup, jusqu'à atteindre une vitesse extrême. Jouez en local ou combattez en ligne.
tagline.en: Lethal League is a competitive projectile fighting game where you have to hit an anti-gravity ball into the face of your opponent to win. The ball speeds up with every strike, up to explosively extreme velocities. Play intense local matches with friends and foes, challenge yourself in the singleplayer mode or battle it out online.

261510.title: Tesla Effect: A Tex Murphy Adventure

tagline.fr: Tex Murphy is the last of the hard-boiled gumshoe detectives living in dystopian post-World War III San Francisco in the 2050s. Tex is an honest and good-natured private investigator with a penchant for bourbon, cigarettes and getting himself into trouble.
tagline.en: Tex Murphy is the last of the hard-boiled gumshoe detectives living in dystopian post-World War III San Francisco in the 2050s. Tex is an honest and good-natured private investigator with a penchant for bourbon, cigarettes and getting himself into trouble.

tagline.fr: Darkest Dungeon est un JdR rogue-like au tour par tour, gothique et sans pitié, sur le stress psychologique de partir à l'aventure. Recrute, entraîne et mène une équipe d'anti-héros au travers de forêts déformées, de tanières oubliées, de cryptes en ruines et au-delà.
tagline.en: Darkest Dungeon is a challenging gothic roguelike turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring. Recruit, train, and lead a team of flawed heroes against unimaginable horrors, stress, disease, and the ever-encroaching dark. Can you keep your heroes together when all hope is lost?

tagline.fr: Mind-altering sandbox game that can be described as a racing role-playing adventure game with a complicated storyline. You’ll find a unique atmosphere, complete freedom and lots of gameplay hours to figure out what’s the game is all about.
tagline.en: Mind-altering sandbox game that can be described as a racing role-playing adventure game with a complicated storyline. You’ll find a unique atmosphere, complete freedom and lots of gameplay hours to figure out what’s the game is all about.

tagline.fr: Experience cinematic kung-fu battles in the fastest, most intense brawler the indie world has ever seen! With the unique 1:1 response system of One Finger Death Punch, players will feel the immediate feedback of every bone-crunching hit. Pay tribute to the masters using five classic kung-fu styles mixed with additional weapons.
tagline.en: Experience cinematic kung-fu battles in the fastest, most intense brawler the indie world has ever seen! With the unique 1:1 response system of One Finger Death Punch, players will feel the immediate feedback of every bone-crunching hit. Pay tribute to the masters using five classic kung-fu styles mixed with additional weapons.

tagline.fr: Descendez dans les profondeurs d'un monde sous-marin étranger plein de merveilles et périls. Concevez des équipements, pilotez des sous-marins, terraformez un terrain voxel, et adaptez-vous à la vie sauvage afin d’explorer le monde, tout en essayant de survivre.
tagline.en: Descend into the depths of an alien underwater world filled with wonder and peril. Craft equipment, pilot submarines and out-smart wildlife to explore lush coral reefs, volcanoes, cave systems, and more - all while trying to survive.

tagline.fr: Heat Signature is a game from the developers of Gunpoint where you break into spaceships, make terrible mistakes, and think of clever ways out of them. You take a mission, fly to the target ship, sneak inside, and make clever use of your gadgets to distract, ambush and take out the crew.
tagline.en: Heat Signature is a game from the developers of Gunpoint where you break into spaceships, make terrible mistakes, and think of clever ways out of them. You take a mission, fly to the target ship, sneak inside, and make clever use of your gadgets to distract, ambush and take out the crew.

tagline.fr: Cuphead, c'est un jeu de plates-formes/action dans la pure veine « run and gun », avec un goût prononcé pour les combats de boss épiques. Inspirés des cartoons américains des années 30, la bande-son et les graphismes ont été créés en respectant scrupuleusement les techniques de l'époque : animation traditionnelle dessinée à la main sur...
tagline.en: Cuphead is a classic run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Inspired by cartoons of the 1930s, the visuals and audio are painstakingly created with the same techniques of the era, i.e. traditional hand drawn cel animation, watercolor backgrounds, and original jazz recordings.

tagline.fr: Il reste trois cibles à abattre ! Déverrouillez The Dishwasher: Vampire Smile pour en savoir plus sur la sanglante vendetta de Yuki.
tagline.en: Il reste trois cibles à abattre ! Déverrouillez The Dishwasher: Vampire Smile pour en savoir plus sur la sanglante vendetta de Yuki.

tagline.fr: Hotline Miami 2 : Wrong Number offre une conclusion frénétique à la saga Hotline Miami, un déchaînement de violence où sera vengé le sang versé dans le premier volet.
tagline.en: Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number is the brutal conclusion to the Hotline Miami saga, set against a backdrop of escalating violence and retribution over spilled blood in the original game.

tagline.fr: Broforce est une ode à la liberté, un run-and-gun à défilement latéral bourré d'action dans lequel vous dirigez une organisation paramilitaire sous-financée et surarmée qui ne jure que par l'usage excessif de la force.
tagline.en: Broforce is an action-packed side-scrolling run ‘n’ gun ode to freedom, putting you in control of an under-funded, overpowered paramilitary organization dealing exclusively in excessive force.

tagline.fr: OlliOlli mixes addictive one-life gameplay with over 120 tricks and grinds across 50 deviously crafted levels, 250 Challenges, Spots Mode and Daily Grind.
tagline.en: OlliOlli mixes addictive one-life gameplay with over 120 tricks and grinds across 50 deviously crafted levels, 250 Challenges, Spots Mode and Daily Grind.

tagline.fr: Darkwood : une nouvelle interprétation du survival-horror. Le jour, fouillez et explorez librement un monde riche et changeant, puis retranchez-vous dans votre refuge et priez pour voir le soleil se lever.
tagline.en: Darkwood - a new perspective on survival horror. Scavenge and explore a rich, ever-changing free-roam world by day, then hunker down in your hideout and pray for the morning light.

tagline.fr: Guacamelee! Super Turbo Championship Edition est la version ultime du jeu à succès d'action-plateforme dans la lignée des Metroidvania. L'aventure originale, inspirée du folklore mexicain, était intense et cocasse. Découvrez vite les nouveautés : niveaux, pouvoirs, défis et autres améliorations.
tagline.en: Guacamelee! Super Turbo Championship Edition est la version ultime du jeu à succès d'action-plateforme dans la lignée des Metroidvania. L'aventure originale, inspirée du folklore mexicain, était intense et cocasse. Découvrez vite les nouveautés : niveaux, pouvoirs, défis et autres améliorations.

tagline.fr: Creeper World 3 is what happens when cellular automata takes over a strategy simulation. Instead of discrete units that attack your base, a fluid-like substance spreads over the terraformable terrain. Your base, your weapons, your strategy... you must adapt them all.
tagline.en: Creeper World 3 is what happens when cellular automata takes over a strategy simulation. Instead of discrete units that attack your base, a fluid-like substance spreads over the terraformable terrain. Your base, your weapons, your strategy... you must adapt them all.

tagline.fr: Vous faites partie d'un groupe de civils qui tentent de survivre dans une ville assiégée ; vous devez faire face aux pénuries de nourriture, de médicaments et au danger permanent que représentent les tireurs d'élite et les collecteurs hostiles.
tagline.en: In This War Of Mine you do not play as an elite soldier, rather a group of civilians trying to survive in a besieged city; struggling with lack of food, medicine and constant danger from snipers and hostile scavengers. The game provides an experience of war seen from an entirely new angle.

tagline.fr: Imaginé par les créateurs d’Amnesia: The Dark Descent, SOMA, mêle science-fiction et horreur sous les vagues de l’océan Atlantique. Lutter pour assurer votre survie dans un monde hostile vous conduira à vous interroger sur votre propre existence.
tagline.en: From the creators of Amnesia: The Dark Descent comes SOMA, a sci-fi horror game set below the waves of the Atlantic ocean. Struggle to survive a hostile world that will make you question your very existence.

tagline.fr: Explore a haunting, punishing island in this stylized 2D action RPG. Salt and Sanctuary combines fast and brutal 2D combat with richly developed RPG mechanics in a cursed realm of forgotten cities, blood-soaked dungeons, and desecrated monuments.
tagline.en: Explore a haunting, punishing island in this stylized 2D action RPG. Salt and Sanctuary combines fast and brutal 2D combat with richly developed RPG mechanics in a cursed realm of forgotten cities, blood-soaked dungeons, and desecrated monuments.

tagline.fr: Something ancient and evil is stirring in Victorian England. Only you can stop it. Journey to the brink of madness and beyond as you set forth alone into the dark.
tagline.en: Something ancient and evil is stirring in Victorian England. Only you can stop it. Journey to the brink of madness and beyond as you set forth alone into the dark.

tagline.fr: Gang Beasts est un jeu multijoueur loufoque avec des personnages gélatineux hargneux, des combats brutalo-comiques, et des lieux absurdement dangereux situés dans la cité de Ville-bœuf.
tagline.en: Gang Beasts is a silly multiplayer party game with surly gelatinous characters, brutal slapstick fight sequences, and absurd hazardous environments, set in the mean streets of Beef City.

tagline.fr: Une mystérieuse invitation vous amène dans le grenier d'une maison abandonnée. Il s'y trouve un coffre orné de gravures étranges et un message de votre correspondant. Il fait l'article d'un objet antique et étonnant conservé dans le coffre-fort : il ne vous reste plus qu'à trouver comment l'ouvrir.
tagline.en: Une mystérieuse invitation vous amène dans le grenier d'une maison abandonnée. Il s'y trouve un coffre orné de gravures étranges et un message de votre correspondant. Il fait l'article d'un objet antique et étonnant conservé dans le coffre-fort : il ne vous reste plus qu'à trouver comment l'ouvrir.

tagline.fr: UN RÉTRO BAWLER RÉVOLUTIONNAIRE QUI DÉFOULE
tagline.en: UN RÉTRO BAWLER RÉVOLUTIONNAIRE QUI DÉFOULE

tagline.fr: Laissez-vous ensorceler par un monde où vos choix et vos actions façonneront votre destinée. Obsidian Entertainment, les développeurs de Fallout: New Vegas™ et de South Park: Le Bâton de la vérité™, en association avec Paradox Interactive, sont très fiers de vous présenter Pillars of Eternity.
tagline.en: Laissez-vous ensorceler par un monde où vos choix et vos actions façonneront votre destinée. Obsidian Entertainment, les développeurs de Fallout: New Vegas™ et de South Park: Le Bâton de la vérité™, en association avec Paradox Interactive, sont très fiers de vous présenter Pillars of Eternity.

tagline.fr: Duet est un jeu élégant et minimaliste dans lequel vous devez simplement manipuler deux sphères à travers un dédale d'obstacles en chute libre de plus en plus complexe. Découvrez une histoire à la narration singulière alors que la difficulté augmente et que la tension monte.
tagline.en: Duet est un jeu élégant et minimaliste dans lequel vous devez simplement manipuler deux sphères à travers un dédale d'obstacles en chute libre de plus en plus complexe. Découvrez une histoire à la narration singulière alors que la difficulté augmente et que la tension monte.

tagline.fr: Crawl is the local multiplayer dungeon crawler where your friends control the monsters! Battle through dungeons and power up your hero - if a friend kills you they take your place and it’s their turn to crawl. It's a race to gain enough XP and loot to take on the hulking final boss!
tagline.en: Crawl is the local multiplayer dungeon crawler where your friends control the monsters! Battle through dungeons and power up your hero - if a friend kills you they take your place and it’s their turn to crawl. It's a race to gain enough XP and loot to take on the hulking final boss!

tagline.fr: Un simulateur de colonie de science-fiction piloté par un narrateur IA intelligent. Il génère des récits interactifs palpitants en simulant la psychologie, l’écologie, les combats, le climat, les biomes, la diplomatie, les relations, l’art, la médecine, le commerce, et bien plus encore.
tagline.en: A sci-fi colony sim driven by an intelligent AI storyteller. Generates stories by simulating psychology, ecology, gunplay, melee combat, climate, biomes, diplomacy, interpersonal relationships, art, medicine, trade, and more.

tagline.fr: Experience the extreme simulated sporting sensation that's sweeping our digital nation! Mount Your Friends is a fiercely competitive sporting event for you to play with your friends in the contextual security of your own home, assuming that your home is not composed of sexual innuendo.
tagline.en: Experience the extreme simulated sporting sensation that's sweeping our digital nation! Mount Your Friends is a fiercely competitive sporting event for you to play with your friends in the contextual security of your own home, assuming that your home is not composed of sexual innuendo.

tagline.fr: Land on a planet, pick up some rocks, leave before the solar system explodes. Oh, and don't die in the nightly robot attacks! Freaking Meatbags is a humorous real-time strategy game that's all about building a base, mixing meatbag DNA, then convincing those dolts to help you gather resources.
tagline.en: Land on a planet, pick up some rocks, leave before the solar system explodes. Oh, and don't die in the nightly robot attacks! Freaking Meatbags is a humorous real-time strategy game that's all about building a base, mixing meatbag DNA, then convincing those dolts to help you gather resources.

tagline.fr: Ils sont arrivés par surprise, avec leurs caquètements menaçants, leurs plumes ébouriffées obscurcissant le soleil. Des poulets intergalactiques venus punir l'humanité pour avoir opprimé depuis des siècles leurs frères de la Terre.
tagline.en: Ils sont arrivés par surprise, avec leurs caquètements menaçants, leurs plumes ébouriffées obscurcissant le soleil. Des poulets intergalactiques venus punir l'humanité pour avoir opprimé depuis des siècles leurs frères de la Terre.

301920.title: War of the Human Tanks - ALTeR

tagline.fr: Human Tanks - ALTeR is the much-awaited second installment of the War of the Human Tanks series, and sequel to War of the Human Tanks. This time you assume command of the enemy of the first game, the Royal Army, and fight back for all you hold dear!
tagline.en: Human Tanks - ALTeR is the much-awaited second installment of the War of the Human Tanks series, and sequel to War of the Human Tanks. This time you assume command of the enemy of the first game, the Royal Army, and fight back for all you hold dear!

tagline.fr: Drive a constantly spinning limousine around town! Roundabout is a '70s B-Movie game where you pick up passengers, find secret collectibles, take on dangerous missions, and fall in love in a far out open world puzzle adventure - all while driving a revolving limo!
tagline.en: Drive a constantly spinning limousine around town! Roundabout is a '70s B-Movie game where you pick up passengers, find secret collectibles, take on dangerous missions, and fall in love in a far out open world puzzle adventure - all while driving a revolving limo!

tagline.fr: Hidden in Plain Sight is a local-multiplayer stealth party game. Blend into the crowd of AI characters and eliminate the other players before they eliminate you!
tagline.en: Hidden in Plain Sight is a local-multiplayer stealth party game. Blend into the crowd of AI characters and eliminate the other players before they eliminate you!

tagline.fr: Seul et pourchassé, un garçon se retrouve entraîné au cœur d'un sombre projet.
tagline.en: Hunted and alone, a boy finds himself drawn into the center of a dark project. INSIDE is a dark, narrative-driven platformer combining intense action with challenging puzzles. It has been critically acclaimed for its moody art style, ambient soundtrack and unsettling atmosphere.

tagline.fr: LOSE YOUR MIND. EAT YOUR CREW. DIE. Take the helm of your steamship and set sail for the unknown! Sunless Sea is a game of discovery, loneliness and frequent death, set in the award-winning Victorian Gothic universe of Fallen London.
tagline.en: LOSE YOUR MIND. EAT YOUR CREW. DIE. Take the helm of your steamship and set sail for the unknown! Sunless Sea is a game of discovery, loneliness and frequent death, set in the award-winning Victorian Gothic universe of Fallen London.

308173.title: Hegemony III: Clash of the Ancients

tagline.fr: Command armies, manage resources, and build an empire in this real-time strategy wargame from Longbow Games. Will Rome fulfil its destiny to rule the ancient world or will history be rewritten to forge a new Etruscan, Gallic, or Greek hegemony!
tagline.en: Command armies, manage resources, and build an empire in this real-time strategy wargame from Longbow Games. Will Rome fulfil its destiny to rule the ancient world or will history be rewritten to forge a new Etruscan, Gallic, or Greek hegemony!

tagline.fr: Enter the Gungeon est un jeu d'exploration d'un donjon où une horde d'aventuriers tiraille à tout va, pille, manie la roulade d'esquive et renverse les tables dans l'espoir de trouver la rédemption.
tagline.en: Enter the Gungeon is a bullet hell dungeon crawler following a band of misfits seeking to shoot, loot, dodge roll and table-flip their way to personal absolution by reaching the legendary Gungeon’s ultimate treasure: the gun that can kill the past.

tagline.fr: Vous êtes un chat-limace nomade, à la fois proie et prédateur, qui évolue dans un écosystème corrompu. Muni de votre lance, affrontez les friches industrielles et chassez pour survivre. Prenez garde.... D'autres créatures, bien plus imposantes, font de même, et raffolent des chats-limaces.
tagline.en: You are a nomadic slugcat, both predator and prey in a broken ecosystem. Grab your spear and brave the industrial wastes, hunting enough food to survive, but be wary— other, bigger creatures have the same plan... and slugcats look delicious.

tagline.fr: Enter the futuristic year of 1984, an age where ducks run wild in a frantic battle for glory. Blast your friends with Shotguns, Net Guns, Mind Control Rays, Saxophones, Magnet Guns, and much, much more. This is DUCK GAME. Don't blink.
tagline.en: Enter the futuristic year of 1984, an age where ducks run wild in a frantic battle for glory. Blast your friends with Shotguns, Net Guns, Mind Control Rays, Saxophones, Magnet Guns, and much, much more. This is DUCK GAME. Don't blink.

tagline.fr: Deathsmiles is CAVE's bullet-hell shoot-'em-up where you take the role of one of five Angels to defend the magical land of Gilverado from an invasion by Hell itself! Eradicate this devilish assault!
tagline.en: Deathsmiles is CAVE's bullet-hell shoot-'em-up where you take the role of one of five Angels to defend the magical land of Gilverado from an invasion by Hell itself! Eradicate this devilish assault!

tagline.fr: Rampage Knights is a cooperative beat 'em up game mixed up with randomized dungeon crawling and exploration, which you can play alone or with a friend online.
tagline.en: Rampage Knights is a cooperative beat 'em up game mixed up with randomized dungeon crawling and exploration, which you can play alone or with a friend online.

tagline.fr: Dans SteamWorld Heist, vous dirigez une escouade de robots dans une série de fusillades tactiques épiques. Dans ce jeu de stratégie au tour par tour novateur, vous visez manuellement avec les pistolets de vos coéquipiers. Tirs spectaculaires garantis !
tagline.en: Command a steam-driven pirate crew in a series of epic tactical shootouts in SteamWorld Heist. This is turn-based strategy with a twist: You manually aim the guns of your robots, allowing for insane skill shots and bullet-bouncing action!

tagline.fr: Don't Starve Together est l’extension multijoueur autonome du jeu de survie intransigeant Don't Starve.
tagline.en: Fight, Farm, Build and Explore Together in the standalone multiplayer expansion to the uncompromising wilderness survival game, Don't Starve.

tagline.fr: SUPERHOT est le premier FPS où le temps ne s'écoule que lorsque vous bougez. Pas de santé qui se régénère. Pas de munitions à récupérer ici et là. Juste vous, face à des hordes d'ennemis mieux armés que vous, à récupérer leurs armes pour les dézinguer, les découper et tenter de survivre au milieu d'un torrent de balles en slow-motion.
tagline.en: SUPERHOT is the smash-hit FPS where time moves only when you move. No regenerating health bars. No conveniently placed ammo drops. It's you, alone, outnumbered and outgunned. Snatch weapons from fallen enemies to shoot, slice and dodge through a truly cinematic hurricane of slow-motion bullets.

tagline.fr: Frostpunk est le premier jeu de survie de société. À la tête de la dernière ville sur Terre, vous gérez ses citoyens et ses infrastructures. Que déciderez-vous pour que votre société survive ? Que ferez-vous lorsque vous serez poussé à bout ? Et surtout, qui allez-vous devenir ?
tagline.en: Frostpunk is the first society survival game. As the ruler of the last city on Earth, it is your duty to manage both its citizens and infrastructure. What decisions will you make to ensure your society's survival? What will you do when pushed to breaking point? Who will you become in the process?

tagline.fr: Children of Morta est un jeu de RPG d'action basé sur une histoire et mettant en scène une famille extraordinaire de héros. Conduisez les Bergson, avec tous leurs défauts et leurs vertus, contre la corruption à venir. Serez-vous capable de tout sacrifier pour sauver ceux que vous aimez?
tagline.en: Children of Morta is a story-driven action RPG game about an extraordinary family of heroes. Lead the Bergsons, with all their flaws and virtues, against the forthcoming Corruption. Will you be able to sacrifice everything to save the ones you care for?

tagline.fr: Explorez et dévoilez le mystère d’un monde extraterrestre surréaliste en explosant des extraterrestres et en parasitant votre environnement dans cet intense jeu d’action/aventure à défilement latéral.
tagline.en: Explore and uncover the mystery of a surreal alien world by blasting aliens and glitching your environment in this intense retro side-scrolling action/adventure.

tagline.fr: Amazing Frog? is an openworld, sandbox, physics game. Grand Frog Auto in Swindon, with farting ragdoll frogs.
tagline.en: Amazing Frog? is an openworld, sandbox, physics game. Grand Frog Auto in Swindon, with farting ragdoll frogs.

tagline.fr: Caves of Qud est un roguelike de science-fiction prenant racine dans un rétrofutur épique, une simulation complexe et une multitude de plantes intelligentes. Rejoignez un monde exotique et découvrez toutes les nuances d'une civilisation millénaire.
tagline.en: Inhabit a deeply-simulated science fantasy world and chisel through layers of thousand-year-old civilizations. Build a character from over a hundred mutations and cybernetics. The award-winning sandbox roguelike & RPG full of robots, deep lore, and sentient plants.

tagline.fr: Le voyage misérable d’un homme brisé...
tagline.en: The miserable journey of a broken man...

tagline.fr: A demon has possessed you and used your body to tear a swath of bloodshed through New York. You are now free, but life as you knew it is over. Your only path forward is joining the Unavowed - an ancient society dedicated to stopping evil. No matter what the cost.
tagline.en: A demon has possessed you and used your body to tear a swath of bloodshed through New York. You are now free, but life as you knew it is over. Your only path forward is joining the Unavowed - an ancient society dedicated to stopping evil. No matter what the cost.

tagline.fr: Paint the Town Red is a chaotic first person melee combat game set in different locations and time periods. The voxel-based enemies can be punched, bashed, kicked, stabbed and sliced completely dynamically using almost anything that isn't nailed down.
tagline.en: Paint the Town Red is a chaotic first person melee combat game set in different locations and time periods. The voxel-based enemies can be punched, bashed, kicked, stabbed and sliced completely dynamically using almost anything that isn't nailed down.

tagline.fr: L’histoire de la vie d’un homme au seuil de la mort, racontée au travers de deux docteurs voyageant dans ses souvenirs pour accomplir son dernier souhait.
tagline.en: Two doctors traverse backwards through a dying man's memories to fulfill his last wish. This is To the Moon's standalone sequel, but can also be played first.

tagline.fr: Vous vous retrouvez seul et piégé dans une salle avec une bombe qui ne vous attend pas. Vos amis ont le manuel qui permettent de la désamorcer, mais ils ne peuvent pas voir la bombe : vous allez devoir parler - et rapidement ! Ce jeu de coopération local requiert deux joueurs ou plus.
tagline.en: Find yourself trapped alone in a room with a ticking time bomb. Your friends have the manual to defuse it, but they can't see the bomb, so you're going to have to talk it out – fast!

tagline.fr: Sur une lune désolée appelée Lorian, une nécro-armure se réveille d'un long sommeil. Vivez une aventure en 2D pleine d'introspection, de mystères ancestraux et de terreurs cosmiques. Explorez de vastes cavernes et débloquez des capacités pour découvrir tous les secrets de ce monde inconnu.
tagline.en: On the desolate moon of Lorian, a long-dormant Deadsuit awakens from slumber. Journey beneath the surface on an atmospheric 2D adventure of self-discovery, ancient mysteries, and cosmic terror. Explore winding caverns and acquire new abilities to unearth this alien world’s long-buried secrets.

tagline.fr: Combattez les gangs de Paris dans ce beat'em all survolté jouable jusqu'à 4 en coopération ou en compétition. Une tonne de contenu déblocable, de nombreux modes de jeu, des combos spectaculaires et des furies dévastatrices vous attendent dans ce jeu de combat technique aux possibilités infinies.
tagline.en: Combattez les gangs de Paris dans ce beat'em all survolté jouable jusqu'à 4 en coopération ou en compétition. Une tonne de contenu déblocable, de nombreux modes de jeu, des combos spectaculaires et des furies dévastatrices vous attendent dans ce jeu de combat technique aux possibilités infinies.

tagline.fr: Thoughts and expectations ARPG
tagline.en: Thoughts and expectations ARPG

tagline.fr: Chicken Invaders puts you at the forefront of a battle against invading intergalactic chickens, bent on revenge for our oppression of Earth chickens. This time, the chickens have hatched a devious plan to block out sunlight and freeze Earth to death!
tagline.en: Chicken Invaders puts you at the forefront of a battle against invading intergalactic chickens, bent on revenge for our oppression of Earth chickens. This time, the chickens have hatched a devious plan to block out sunlight and freeze Earth to death!

tagline.fr: A simple 3d puzzle game.
tagline.en: A simple 3d puzzle game.

tagline.fr: Construisez les voies, gérez le trafic et évitez les accidents, en Europe, en Amérique, au Japon et en URSS, de 1830 à 2020. Explorez le mode histoire, de la ruée vers l'or de 1849 aux premiers vols spatiaux habités, puis le mode aléatoire. Bienvenue dans Train Valley!
tagline.en: Construisez les voies, gérez le trafic et évitez les accidents, en Europe, en Amérique, au Japon et en URSS, de 1830 à 2020. Explorez le mode histoire, de la ruée vers l'or de 1849 aux premiers vols spatiaux habités, puis le mode aléatoire. Bienvenue dans Train Valley!

tagline.fr: Embark on a thrilling adventure through sheet music in Tadpole Treble! Escape predatory piranhas, flirtatious tadpoles and more as you make your way back home. Shoot for the top of the leaderboards, or create your own stages and music in Composition Mode!
tagline.en: Embark on a thrilling adventure through sheet music in Tadpole Treble! Escape predatory piranhas, flirtatious tadpoles and more as you make your way back home. Shoot for the top of the leaderboards, or create your own stages and music in Composition Mode!

tagline.fr: À la fois rythmé et violent, Thumper réunit toute l'action des jeux de rythme classiques, des vitesses foudroyantes et une réalité physique impitoyable. Vous êtes un scarabée de l'espace. Bravez le vide infernal et confrontez une gigantesque tête déchaînée venue du futur.
tagline.en: Thumper is rhythm violence: classic rhythm-action, blistering speed, and brutal physicality. You are a space beetle. Brave the hellish void and confront a maniacal giant head from the future.

tagline.fr: The Epic Time Travel Adventure Begins! The origin of the acclaimed Journeyman Project series.
tagline.en: The Epic Time Travel Adventure Begins! The origin of the acclaimed Journeyman Project series.

tagline.fr: Downwell is a curious game about a young person venturing down a well in search of untold treasures with only his Gunboots to protect him.
tagline.en: Downwell is a curious game about a young person venturing down a well in search of untold treasures with only his Gunboots to protect him.

tagline.fr: Interagissez avec de nouveaux mondes étranges d'une manière unique et tactile, en modelant l'environnement comme si vous sculptiez de la glaise. Travaillez seul ou à plusieurs pour construire votre base, maîtriser la gestion des ressources et bien plus encore dans ce bac à sable spatial!
tagline.en: Interact with strange new worlds in a unique and tactile way, molding the environment itself as if it were clay in your hands. Build your base, master resource management, automate your production lines, and more as you unravel the mysteries of the universe, alone or with friends.

tagline.fr: Fran Bow is a creepy adventure game that tells the story of Fran, a young girl struggling with a mental disorder and an unfair destiny.
tagline.en: Fran Bow is a creepy adventure game that tells the story of Fran, a young girl struggling with a mental disorder and an unfair destiny.

tagline.fr: Gérez une compagnie de mercenaires dans ce RPG tactique de fantasy médiévale. Choisissez votre voie, vos recrues, vos contrats et l’entraînement de vos frères d’armes pour remporter la gloire et la fortune dans la campagne de ce monde ouvert généré procéduralement.
tagline.en: Lead a mercenary company in this tactical RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Chase fame and fortune as you choose where to go, who to recruit, which contracts to pursue, and how to train and equip your men in a procedurally generated open world campaign.

tagline.fr: Drop in to Olliwood and prepare for finger-flippin’ mayhem in this follow up to cult skateboarding smash OlliOlli.
tagline.en: Drop in to Olliwood and prepare for finger-flippin’ mayhem in this follow up to cult skateboarding smash OlliOlli.

tagline.fr: Colony Survival est un jeu de stratégie à la première personne unique, développé par une équipe de deux personnes. Construisez votre propre colonie dans un monde en voxels. Dirigez des gardes, fermiers, mineurs et autres colons. Défendez votre colonie contre la horde de monstres qui attaque chaque nuit !
tagline.en: Colony Survival est un jeu de stratégie à la première personne unique, développé par une équipe de deux personnes. Construisez votre propre colonie dans un monde en voxels. Dirigez des gardes, fermiers, mineurs et autres colons. Défendez votre colonie contre la horde de monstres qui attaque chaque nuit !

tagline.fr: Choisissez votre destin dans Hollow Knight ! Une aventure épique et pleine d’action, qui vous plongera dans un vaste royaume en ruine peuplé d’insectes et de héros. Dans un monde en 2D classique, dessiné à la main.
tagline.en: Forge your own path in Hollow Knight! An epic action adventure through a vast ruined kingdom of insects and heroes. Explore twisting caverns, battle tainted creatures and befriend bizarre bugs, all in a classic, hand-drawn 2D style.

tagline.fr: CrossCode, jeu d'action RPG rétro en 2D, mêle graphismes 16 bits de style SNES à des effets physiques fluides, un système de combat intense et des mécanismes de puzzle intéressants, le tout enveloppé dans une histoire de science-fiction captivante.
tagline.en: A retro-inspired 2D Action RPG set in the distant future. CrossCode combines 16-bit SNES-style graphics with butter-smooth physics, a fast-paced combat system, and engaging puzzle mechanics, served with a gripping sci-fi story.

tagline.fr: Enfilez votre imper, activez votre sixième sens et rejoignez les rangs afin d’enquêter sur les événements étranges dangereux et perturbants qui entourent Twin Lakes. Tentacules avides de chair humaine, zombies mafieux ou encore chaussette manquante. L’inspecteur du Côté Obscur ne recule devant rien.
tagline.en: Enfilez votre imper, activez votre sixième sens et rejoignez les rangs afin d’enquêter sur les événements étranges dangereux et perturbants qui entourent Twin Lakes. Tentacules avides de chair humaine, zombies mafieux ou encore chaussette manquante. L’inspecteur du Côté Obscur ne recule devant rien.

tagline.fr: Remontez dans le temps pour changer le destin dans cette superbe et passionnante aventure, inspirée des jeux d'action plateforme classiques des années 90.
tagline.en: Travel back in time to change fate itself, in this beautifully crafted story-driven adventure, inspired by classic 90s action-platformers. Join timekeeper Lunais on her quest for revenge against the empire that killed her family, using time-bending powers to explore a vast, connected world.

tagline.fr: Spot the lie and beat the liars in 'Contradiction' - the all-video murder mystery adventure!
tagline.en: Spot the lie and beat the liars in 'Contradiction' - the all-video murder mystery adventure!

tagline.fr: Utilisez l’appareil magique connu comme le Chronicon pour voyager dans les âmes et les souvenirs de héros déchus pour revivre leurs grandes sagas ! Des aventures épiques remplies de butin et de monstres vous attendent !
tagline.en: Utilisez l’appareil magique connu comme le Chronicon pour voyager dans les âmes et les souvenirs de héros déchus pour revivre leurs grandes sagas ! Des aventures épiques remplies de butin et de monstres vous attendent !

tagline.fr: 1872, with a steampunk twist. Phileas Fogg has wagered he can circumnavigate the world in just 80 days. Travel by airship, submarine, mechanical camel, steam-train and more. Race other players and a clock that never stops in TIME Magazine's Game of 2014.
tagline.en: 1872, with a steampunk twist. Phileas Fogg has wagered he can circumnavigate the world in just 80 days. Travel by airship, submarine, mechanical camel, steam-train and more. Race other players and a clock that never stops in TIME Magazine's Game of 2014.

tagline.fr: Firewatch est un jeu plein de mystères pour un joueur à la première personne, qui se déroule dans le décor sauvage du Wyoming.
tagline.en: Firewatch is a single-player first-person mystery set in the Wyoming wilderness, where your only emotional lifeline is the person on the other end of a handheld radio.

tagline.fr: RIVALS OF AETHER is an indie fighting game where warring civilizations summon the power of Fire, Water, Air, and Earth. Play with up to four players either locally or online.
tagline.en: RIVALS OF AETHER is an indie fighting game where warring civilizations summon the power of Fire, Water, Air, and Earth. Play with up to four players either locally or online.

tagline.fr: The hottest bird lawyering game to come out of 1840s France! Join Jayjay Falcon and his witty apprentice, Sparrowson, as the two take on clients, interview witnesses, collect evidence, and deliver justice to the guilty.
tagline.en: The hottest bird lawyering game to come out of 1840s France! Join Jayjay Falcon and his witty apprentice, Sparrowson, as the two take on clients, interview witnesses, collect evidence, and deliver justice to the guilty.

tagline.fr: Ultimate Chicken Horse est un jeu de plateformes festif qui vous permet de construire le niveau tout en jouant et en plaçant des pièges et autres dangers pour attraper vos amis tout en essayant de ne pas vous attraper vous-même.
tagline.en: Ultimate Chicken Horse is a party platformer game where you build the level as you play, placing traps and hazards to screw your friends over, but trying not to screw yourself.

tagline.fr: Oxenfree est un thriller surnaturel mettant en scène un groupe d'amis qui ouvre malencontreusement une faille spectrale. Vous êtes Alex, et vous venez d'amener votre demi-frère, Jonas, sur une île pour une fête nocturne qui tourne horriblement mal.
tagline.en: Oxenfree is a supernatural thriller about a group of friends who unwittingly open a ghostly rift. You are Alex, and you’ve just brought your new stepbrother Jonas to an overnight island party gone horribly wrong.

tagline.fr: UNDERTALE! The RPG game where you don't have to destroy anyone.
tagline.en: UNDERTALE! The RPG game where you don't have to destroy anyone.

tagline.fr: Bleed 2 is a relentless arcade action game featuring air-dodging, bullet-reflecting, and tons of bosses. Now with randomly-generated levels and daily challenges, too!
tagline.en: Bleed 2 is a relentless arcade action game featuring air-dodging, bullet-reflecting, and tons of bosses. Now with randomly-generated levels and daily challenges, too!

tagline.fr: The sequel to the party game phenomenon The Jackbox Party Pack, featuring FIVE fresh, rib-tickling party games! Your phones or tablets are your controllers – no big mess of controllers needed. For up to 8 players plus an Audience of up to 10,000! It’s a game-night riot in a box… without the box!
tagline.en: The sequel to the party game phenomenon The Jackbox Party Pack, featuring FIVE fresh, rib-tickling party games! Your phones or tablets are your controllers – no big mess of controllers needed. For up to 8 players plus an Audience of up to 10,000! It’s a game-night riot in a box… without the box!

tagline.fr: Dodge bullets, missiles and lasers in battle as you wrap your head around that bunny girl costume! Combo away with your mighty Piko Hammer or spam various spells from afar with your fiery fairy friend. Explore and explode through Rabi-Rabi Island as you collect power-ups and uncover secrets...
tagline.en: Dodge bullets, missiles and lasers in battle as you wrap your head around that bunny girl costume! Combo away with your mighty Piko Hammer or spam various spells from afar with your fiery fairy friend. Explore and explode through Rabi-Rabi Island as you collect power-ups and uncover secrets...

tagline.fr: A ridiculous live-action B-movie adventure you will never forget! You wake up to find your town in chaos. Everyone has gone crazy and is just attacking each other! A cryptic message is the secret to survival-- Press X to not die!
tagline.en: A ridiculous live-action B-movie adventure you will never forget! You wake up to find your town in chaos. Everyone has gone crazy and is just attacking each other! A cryptic message is the secret to survival-- Press X to not die!

402530.title: The Last Door: Season 2 - Collector's Edition

tagline.fr: In Season 2 of The Last Door, the search for his missing client will bring psychiatrist John Wakefield deeper into a conspiracy of darkness and closer to the heart of madness than ever before.
tagline.en: In Season 2 of The Last Door, the search for his missing client will bring psychiatrist John Wakefield deeper into a conspiracy of darkness and closer to the heart of madness than ever before.

tagline.fr: The Consuming Shadow is a procedural survival horror adventure in which you must explore the land, fight your way through randomly-generated dungeons and try to stay sane in your quest to save the world from the invading Ancients.
tagline.en: The Consuming Shadow is a procedural survival horror adventure in which you must explore the land, fight your way through randomly-generated dungeons and try to stay sane in your quest to save the world from the invading Ancients.

tagline.fr: L'apocalypse punk rock a frappé ! Avec vos amis, aidez le groupe punk rock Charlie Murder, assiégé, dans sa quête épique pour sauver le monde de leurs rivaux métalleux Gore Quaffer et leurs armées du mal.
tagline.en: L'apocalypse punk rock a frappé ! Avec vos amis, aidez le groupe punk rock Charlie Murder, assiégé, dans sa quête épique pour sauver le monde de leurs rivaux métalleux Gore Quaffer et leurs armées du mal.

tagline.fr: Pony Island est un jeu de puzzle inquiétant. Vous êtes dans les limbes, piégé dans une borne d'arcade malveillante et dysfonctionnante conçue par le diable lui-même. Ce n'est pas un jeu sur les poneys.
tagline.en: Pony Island is a suspense puzzle game in disguise. You are in limbo, trapped in a malevolent and malfunctioning arcade machine devised by the devil himself. It is not a game about ponies.

407900.title: Princess Remedy in a World of Hurt

tagline.fr: Remedy, a recent graduate from the Saturnian healing school, must descend to Hurtland and use her powers to heal everyone from stray ducks to dark lords, and finally cure the ailing Prince Hingst. It's a short, whimsical adventure with plenty of heart(s).
tagline.en: Remedy, a recent graduate from the Saturnian healing school, must descend to Hurtland and use her powers to heal everyone from stray ducks to dark lords, and finally cure the ailing Prince Hingst. It's a short, whimsical adventure with plenty of heart(s).

409450.title: The Fall of the Dungeon Guardians - Enhanced Edition

tagline.fr: Dans cette fusion entre un jeu de combat tactique et un jeu de donjon, explorez un donjon massif, rempli de dangers, de mystère et de secrets. Affrontez des hordes d’ennemis et de puissants monstres avec votre équipe de tank, guérisseur et faiseurs de dégâts.
tagline.en: Dans cette fusion entre un jeu de combat tactique et un jeu de donjon, explorez un donjon massif, rempli de dangers, de mystère et de secrets. Affrontez des hordes d’ennemis et de puissants monstres avec votre équipe de tank, guérisseur et faiseurs de dégâts.

tagline.fr: Liftoff® is a drone simulator that translates the rush of first-person view drone flight to the digital world. Join the biggest community for virtual FPV racing and freestyle!
tagline.en: Liftoff® is a drone simulator that translates the rush of first-person view drone flight to the digital world. Join the biggest community for virtual FPV racing and freestyle!

tagline.fr: Évite des centaines de milliers de belles attaques!Bullet Heaven 2 est un shoot-em-up tiré de l’univers d’Epic Battle Fantasy.Tire sur tout ce qui bouge tout en évitant des centaines d’attaques par seconde!
tagline.en: Évite des centaines de milliers de belles attaques!Bullet Heaven 2 est un shoot-em-up tiré de l’univers d’Epic Battle Fantasy.Tire sur tout ce qui bouge tout en évitant des centaines d’attaques par seconde!

tagline.fr: You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home?
tagline.en: You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home?

tagline.fr: An indie turn-based Tactics RPG with a heavy emphasis on exploration, character progression, and highly tactical combat. Create your own deeply customizable party of Warriors, Sorcerers, and Shiftcloaks to take on the Spire!
tagline.en: An indie turn-based Tactics RPG with a heavy emphasis on exploration, character progression, and highly tactical combat. Create your own deeply customizable party of Warriors, Sorcerers, and Shiftcloaks to take on the Spire!

tagline.fr: Spelunky 2 étoffe les défis aléatoires et uniques de son prédécesseur roguelike, offrant une aventure satisfaisante pour les anciens joueurs comme pour les nouveaux. Rencontrez la prochaine génération d'explorateurs lunaires, à la recherche de trésors et de proches disparus.
tagline.en: Spelunky 2 builds upon the unique, randomized challenges that made the original a roguelike classic, offering a huge adventure designed to satisfy players old and new. Meet the next generation of explorers as they find themselves on the Moon, searching for treasure and missing family.

tagline.fr: Business is booming for La Soleil, the patisserie run by Kashou Minaduki with his two catgirls, Chocola and Vanilla, his sister Shigure, and the Minaduki family's four catgirl sisters.
tagline.en: Business is booming for La Soleil, the patisserie run by Kashou Minaduki with his two catgirls, Chocola and Vanilla, his sister Shigure, and the Minaduki family's four catgirl sisters.

tagline.fr: Lost Technology is a simulation game in which more than 100 characters belonging to 12 different factions battle to conquer each other’s territories. The faction you choose at the beginning will determine the conversations and events that unfold throughout the game between you and other factions.
tagline.en: Lost Technology is a simulation game in which more than 100 characters belonging to 12 different factions battle to conquer each other’s territories. The faction you choose at the beginning will determine the conversations and events that unfold throughout the game between you and other factions.

tagline.fr: OneShot est un jeu d'aventure/d'énigmes surréaliste en vue du dessus et doté d'un gameplay unique. Vous devez guider un enfant dans sa mission à travers un monde mystérieux : restaurer un soleil éteint depuis bien longtemps. Le monde vous attend.
tagline.en: OneShot is a surreal top down Puzzle/Adventure game with unique gameplay capabilities. You are to guide a child through a mysterious world on a mission to restore its long-dead sun. The world knows you exist.

tagline.fr: Build and design your own fleets and stand opposed to the Particulate in this physics/strategy/RTS/fleet hybrid. Build partially destructible and self repairing ships that interact with enemies less controlled by some scripted logic and more driven by a real time massive physics particle simulation.
tagline.en: Build and design your own fleets and stand opposed to the Particulate in this physics/strategy/RTS/fleet hybrid. Build partially destructible and self repairing ships that interact with enemies less controlled by some scripted logic and more driven by a real time massive physics particle simulation.

tagline.fr: Deceptively simple... amazingly deep. Creeper World 2 thrusts you into the 14th millennium fighting and enemy that flows and oozes through the terrain. Employ advanced weapons,gravity manipulating repulsors, wormhole like rifts, and your own wit against this never yielding enemy.
tagline.en: Deceptively simple... amazingly deep. Creeper World 2 thrusts you into the 14th millennium fighting and enemy that flows and oozes through the terrain. Employ advanced weapons,gravity manipulating repulsors, wormhole like rifts, and your own wit against this never yielding enemy.

tagline.fr: Devil Daggers is a fast-paced shooter that places you in an abyssal arena to face endless legions of demons. Armed with versatile magic daggers and a fluid movement system, fight to survive as long as you can.
tagline.en: Devil Daggers is a fast-paced shooter that places you in an abyssal arena to face endless legions of demons. Armed with versatile magic daggers and a fluid movement system, fight to survive as long as you can.

tagline.fr: Iron Snout is a fast, colorful and brutal fighting game in which you will be helping a piglet fight for its life against hordes of wolves.
tagline.en: Iron Snout is a fast, colorful and brutal fighting game in which you will be helping a piglet fight for its life against hordes of wolves.

tagline.fr: Des événements imprévisibles vous transportent dans une crypte oubliée depuis longtemps. Le seul moyen de vous enfuir est enfermé dans un piédestal en pierre, de même qu'une note de votre mystérieux allié.
tagline.en: Des événements imprévisibles vous transportent dans une crypte oubliée depuis longtemps. Le seul moyen de vous enfuir est enfermé dans un piédestal en pierre, de même qu'une note de votre mystérieux allié.

tagline.fr: Jeu de survie en coop (1-6 joueurs) qui se déroule dans un centre menacé par des phénomènes paranormaux. Vous qui incarnez les scientifiques les plus brillants, vous devrez fabriquer des outils et des armes, et survivre de la seule manière qui vous est familière: tuez-les avec la science!
tagline.en: Abiotic Factor is a survival crafting experience for 1-6 players set in the depths of an underground research facility. Caught between paranormal containment failure, a military crusade, and chaos from a dozen realms, the world’s greatest minds must survive against the universe’s biggest threats.

tagline.fr: Factorio a pour but la création d'une usine complètement automatisée, produisant des éléments de plus en plus complexes, dans un monde en 2D. Utiliser votre imagination pour concevoir votre usine, combiner de simples éléments en ingénieuses structures, tout en vous protégeant des aliens !
tagline.en: Factorio is a game about building and creating automated factories to produce items of increasing complexity, within an infinite 2D world. Use your imagination to design your factory, combine simple elements into ingenious structures, and finally protect it from the creatures who don't really like you.

tagline.fr: Racquetball meets Breakout inside a giant pinball machine! Racket: Nx is a new kind of game that challenges the limits of what you can do with a racket and ball in VR.
tagline.en: Racquetball meets Breakout inside a giant pinball machine! Racket: Nx is a new kind of game that challenges the limits of what you can do with a racket and ball in VR.

tagline.fr: Reverie Under the Moonlight est le quatrième opus dans la série populaire de jeux de plate-formes en 2D Momodora. Faites usage des combos et de l'agilité de Kaho pour vous frayer un chemin dans une contrée maudite, prendre audience auprès de la Reine, et dissiper le mal qui menace l'humanité.
tagline.en: Momodora: Reverie Under The Moonlight is the fourth installment in the beloved Momodora series of 2D platformers. Unleash ravaging combos against a variety of formidable monsters and deftly dodge your way through a cursed land to seek audience with the Queen and dispel the evil that threatens all life.

tagline.fr: Astro Duel est un jeu festif local en multijoueurs. Les manches sont rapides et les morts sans pitié. Envoyez vos amis dans l'espace, et profitez-en pour écraser leurs corps sans défense.
tagline.en: Astro Duel est un jeu festif local en multijoueurs. Les manches sont rapides et les morts sans pitié. Envoyez vos amis dans l'espace, et profitez-en pour écraser leurs corps sans défense.

tagline.fr: Slime Rancher raconte l'histoire de Beatrix LeBeau, une jeune éleveuse de Slimes courageuse, qui part vivre sa vie à plus de mille années-lumière de la Terre, sur Far, Far Ouest, où elle tente de vivre grâce à l'élevage de Slimes.
tagline.en: Slime Rancher is the tale of Beatrix LeBeau, a plucky, young rancher who sets out for a life a thousand light years away from Earth on the ‘Far, Far Range’ where she tries her hand at making a living wrangling slimes.
